prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” HVAC company for AC repair in Houston — the right choice depends on your location, budget, urgency, and whether you want a big company or a trusted local tech. That said, some companies consistently get strong local reviews (examples: John Moore Services, ARS/Rescue Rooter, and One Hour Heating & Air) — and many excellent independent contractors serve Houston neighborhoods.

To pick the best one for your situation, use these quick steps and questions:

What to check
- Licensing and insurance: ask for their Texas HVAC license and proof of liability insurance.
- Technician credentials: look for NATE-certified techs or manufacturer training.
- Reviews and reputation: check Google, Yelp, Angi, and the BBB for recent feedback.
- Warranties: ask about labor and parts warranty (get it in writing).
- Emergency response: do they offer 24/7 service and same-day repairs?
- Upfront pricing: get a written estimate and ask if there’s a diagnostic fee and how it’s applied.
- Brand familiarity: ensure they routinely service your AC brand or system type (split, packaged, heat pump).

Questions to ask when you call
- “Are you licensed and insured?”
- “What is the diagnostic fee and is it waived if I proceed with repair?”
- “What warranty do you offer on parts and labor?”
- “Have you worked on [brand/model] before?”
- “Can you give a written estimate and an estimated time to complete the repair?”

Red flags
- No license or insurance
- Very vague estimates or high-pressure sales to replace units immediately
- Poor or no online reviews / many unresolved complaints

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and whether this is residential or commercial and I’ll pull up the top-rated nearby companies and recent review highlights so you can compare options.
